🔄 Content updated (Published: August 13, 2026 / Last posted: August 13, 2026)
Main changes: Alert issue time changed from 6:07 PM to 3:12 PM, and shelter locations expanded to 7 districts by adding Hanno Central and Higashi-Agano district administrative centers.

Following the issuance of a "Level 4 Sediment Disaster Warning" at 3:12 PM today, voluntary evacuation shelters have been opened at the Hanno Central, Kaji, Kaji-Higashi, Agano, Higashi-Agano, Haraichiba, and Naguri district administrative centers.

※ Voluntary evacuation shelters do not provide food, daily necessities, or other supplies as a general rule.

If you evacuate, please bring essential supplies with you in advance.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/emergency/11997.html
summary: ℹ️ Voluntary evacuation shelters have been opened
